verses.translation: And the sons of Juda; Phares, Esrom, and Charmi, and Or, Subal,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iuda au fost: Fares, Heţron, Carmi, Hur şi Şobal.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα, Φαρὲς, Ἐσρὼμ, καὶ Χαρμὶ, καὶ Ὢρ, Σουβὰλ,

verses.translation: and Rada his son; and Subal begot Jeth; and Jeth begot Achimai, and Laad: these are the generations of the Arathites.

translations.ron: Reaia, fiul lui Şobal, a avut fiu pe Iahat; lui Iahat i s-a născut Ahumai şi Lahad. Din el se trag familiile Ţoreenilor.
translations.grk: καὶ Ῥάδα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ· καὶ Σουβὰλ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰέθ· καὶ Ἰὲθ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἀχιμαῒ, καὶ τὸν Λαάδ· αὗται αἱ γενέσεις τοῦ Ἀραθί.

verses.translation: And these are the sons of Ætam; Jezrael and Jesman, and Jebdas: and their sister's name was Eselebbon.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Etam sunt: Izreel, Işma şi Idbaş, şi sora lor cu numele Haţlelponi.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αἰτὰμ, Ἰεζραὴλ, καὶ Ἰεσμὰν, καὶ Ἰεβδάς· καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφῆς αὐτῶν Ἐσηλεββών.

verses.translation: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Jazer the father of Osan: these are the sons of Or, the first-born of Ephratha, the father of Bæthalaen.

translations.ron: Panuel, tatăl lui Ghedor şi Ezer, tatăl lui Huşa sunt fiii lui Hur, întâiul născut din Efrata şi tatăl lui Betleem.
translations.grk: Καὶ Φανουὴλ πατὴρ Γεδὼρ, καὶ Ἰαζὴρ πατὴρ Ὠσάν· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ὢρ τοῦ πρωτοτόκου Ἐφραθὰ πατρὸς Βαιθαλαέν.

verses.translation: And Asur the father of Thecoe had two wives, Aoda and Thoada.

translations.ron: Aşhur, tatăl lui Tecoa, a avut două femei: pe Helea şi Naara.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Ἀσοὺρ πατρὶ Θεκωὲ ἦσαν δύο γυναῖκες, Ἀωδὰ, καὶ Θοαδά.

verses.translation: And Aoda bore to him Ochaia, and Ephal, and Thæman, and Aasther: all these were the sons of Aoda.

translations.ron: Naara i-a născut pe Ahuzam, Hefer, Temni şi Ahaştari. Aceştia sunt fiii Naarei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Ἀωδὰ τὸν Ὠχαία, καὶ τὸν Ἠφὰλ, καὶ τὸν Θαιμὰν, καὶ τὸν Ἀασθήρ· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀωδᾶς.

verses.translation: And the sons of Thoada; Sereth, and Saar, and Esthanam.

translations.ron: Iar fiii Helei sunt: Ţeret, Ţohar Etna şi Coţ.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Θοαδᾶς, Σερὲθ, καὶ Σαὰρ, καὶ Ἐσθανάμ.

verses.translation: And Coe begot Enob, and Sabatha, and the progeny of the brother of Rechab, the son of Jarin.

translations.ron: Lui Coţ i s-au născut: Anub, Ţobeba, Iaheţ şi familiile lui Aharhel, fiul lui Harum.
translations.grk: Καὶ Κωὲ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἐνὼβ, καὶ τὸν Σαβαθά· καὶ γεννήσεις ἀδελφοῦ Ῥηχὰβ, υἱοῦ Ἰαρίν.

verses.translation: And Igabes was more famous than his brethren; and his mother called his name Igabes, saying, I have born as a sorrowful one.

translations.ron: Iabeţ a fost mai însemnat decât fraţii săi. Mama lui i-a dat numele de Iabeţ, zicând: "Cu durere l-am născut".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν Ἰγαβὴς ἔνδοξος ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἡ μήτηρ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰγαβὴς, λέγουσα, ἔτεκον ὡς γαβής.

verses.translation: And Igabes called on the God of Israel, saying, O that thou wouldest indeed bless me, and enlarge my coasts, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest make me know that thou wilt not grieve me! And God granted him all that he asked.

translations.ron: Şi a strigat Iabeţ către Dumnezeul lui Israel şi a zis: "O, de m-ai binecuvânta Tu cu binecuvântare, de ai lărgi hotarele mele şi de ar fi mâna Ta cu mine, păzindu-mă de rele, ca să nu fiu omorât!..." Atunci Dumnezeu i-a trimis ceea ce a dorit el.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο Ἰγαβὴς τὸν Θεὸν Ἰσραὴλ, λέγων, ἐὰν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσῃς με, καὶ πληθύνῃς τὰ ὅριά μου, καὶ ᾖ ἡ χείρ σου μετʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ ποιήσῃς γνῶσιν τοῦ μὴ ταπεινῶσαί με· καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ὁ Θεὸς πάντα ὅσα ᾐτήσατο.

verses.translation: And Chaleb the father of Ascha begot Machir; he was the father of Assathon.

translations.ron: Şi lui Chelub, fratele lui Şuha, i s-a născut Mehir. Acesta e tatăl lui Eşton.
translations.grk: Καὶ Χαλὲβ πατὴρ Ἀσχὰ ἐγέννησε τὸν Μαχίρ· οὗτος πατὴρ Ἀσσαθών.

verses.translation: He begot Bathraias, and Besseë, and Thæman the founder of the city of Naas the brother of Eselom the Kenezite: these were the men of Rechab.

translations.ron: Lui Eşton i s-au născut Bet-Rafa, Paseah şi Techina, tatăl cetăţii Nahaş; aceştia sunt locuitorii din Recab.
translations.grk: Ἐγέννησε τὸν Βαθραίαν, καὶ τὸν Βεσσηὲ, καὶ τὸν Θαιμὰν πατέρα πόλεως Ναᾶς ἀδελφοῦ Ἐσελὼμ τοῦ Κενεζί· οὗτοι ἄνδρες Ῥηχάβ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Kenez; Gothoniel, and Saraia: and the sons of Gothoniel; Athath.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Chenaz sunt Otniel şi Seraia. Fiii lui Otniel au fost Hatat şi Meonotai.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Κενὲζ, Γοθονιὴλ, καὶ Σαραΐα· καὶ υἱοὶ Γοθονιὴλ, Ἀθάθ.

verses.translation: And Manathi begot Gophera: and Saraia begot Jobab, the father of Ageaddair, for they were artificers.

translations.ron: Lui Meonotai i s-a născut Ofra. Lui Seraia i s-a născut Ioab, strămoşul lui Gheharaşim, numiţi aşa pentru că ei erau dulgheri.
translations.grk: Καὶ Μαναθὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν Γοφερά. καὶ Σαραΐα ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰωβὰβ, πατέρα Ἀγεαδδαῒρ, ὅτι τέκτονες ἦσαν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Chaleb the son of Jephonne; Er, Ada, and Noom: and the sons of Ada, Kenez.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Caleb, fiul lui Iefoni, au fost: Ir, Ela şi Naam. Fiul lui Ela a fost Chenaz.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χαλὲβ υἱοῦ Ἰεφοννὴ, Ἢρ, Ἀδὰ, καὶ Νοόμ· καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀδὰ, Κενέζ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Aleel, Zib, and Zepha, and Thiria, and Eserel.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iehaleleel au fost: Zif, Zifa, Tiria şi Asareel.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀλεὴλ, Ζὶβ, καὶ Ζεφὰ, καὶ Θιριὰ, καὶ Ἐσερήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Esri; Jether, Morad, and Apher, and Jamon: and Jether begot Maron, and Semei, and Jesba the father of Esthæmon.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ezra sunt: Ieter, Mered, Efer şi Ialon; iar lui Ieter i s-au născut Miriam, Şamai şi Işbah, tatăl lui Eştemoa.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐσρὶ, Ἰεθὲρ, Μωρὰδ, καὶ Ἄφερ, καὶ Ἰαμών· καὶ ἐγέννησεν Ἰεθὲρ τὸν Μαρὼν, καὶ τὸν Σεμεῒ, καὶ τὸν Ἰεσβὰ πατέρα Ἐσθαίμων·

verses.translation: And his wife, that is Adia, bore Jared the father of Gedor, and Aber the father of Sochon, and Chetiel the father of Zamon: and these are the sons of Betthia the daughter of Pharao, whom Mored took.

translations.ron: Femeia acestuia, Iehudia, a născut pe Iered, tatăl lui Ghedor, pe Heber, tatăl lui Soco, şi pe Iecutiel, tatăl lui Zanoah. Aceştia sunt fiii Bitiei, fata lui Faraon, pe care a luat-o Mered.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ αὕτη Ἀδία, ἔτεκε τὸν Ἰάρεδ πατέρα Γεδὼρ, καὶ τὸν Ἀβὲρ πατέρα Σωχὼν, καὶ τὸν Χετιὴλ πατέρα Ζαμών· καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βετθία θυγατρὸς Φαραὼ, ἣν ἔλαβε Μωρήδ.

verses.translation: And the sons of the wife of Iduia the sister of Nachaim the father of Keila; Garmi, and Esthæmon the Nochathite.

translations.ron: Fiii femeii acestuia, Hodia, sora lui Naham, tatăl Cheilei, sunt: Garmi şi Eştemoa Maacateanul.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ γυναικὸς τῆς Ἰδουίας ἀδελφῆς Ναχαῒμ πατρὸς Κεϊλὰ, Γαρμὶ, καὶ Ἐσθαιμὼν Νωχαθί.

verses.translation: And the sons of Semon; Amnon, and Ana the son of Phana, and Inon: and the sons of Sei, Zoan, and the sons of Zoab.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Simeon sunt: Amnon, Rina, Benhanan şi Tilon. Fiii lui Işi sunt Zohet şi Benzohet.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Σεμὼν, Αμνὼν, καὶ Ἀνὰ υἱὸς Φανὰ, καὶ Ἰνών· καὶ υἱοὶ Σεῒ, Ζωὰν, καὶ υἱοὶ Ζωάβ.

verses.translation: The sons of Selom the son of Juda; Er the father of Lechab, and Laada the father of Marisa, and the offspring of the family of Ephrathabac belonging to the house of Esoba.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şela, fiul lui Iuda, sunt: Er, tatăl lui Leca, Laeda, tatăl lui Mareşa, şi familiile din casa lui Aşbeia, care lucrau visonul,
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σηλὼμ υἱοῦ Ἰούδα, Ἢρ πατὴρ Ληχὰβ, καὶ Λααδὰ πατὴρ Μαρισά· καὶ γενέσεις οἰκείων Ἐφραθαβὰκ τῷ οἴκῳ Ἐσοβὰ,

verses.translation: And Joakim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joas, and Saraph, who dwelt in Moab, and he changed their names to Abederin and Athukiim.

translations.ron: Iochim şi locuitorii din Cozeba; Ioaş şi Saraf, care au stăpânit asupra Moabului şi Iaşubi-Lehem. Dar acestea sunt întâmplări mai vechi.
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰωακὶμ, καὶ ἄνδρες Χωζηβὰ, καὶ Ἰωὰς, καὶ Σαρὰφ, οἳ κατῴκησαν ἐν Μωάβ· καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν αὐτος ἀβεδηρὶν, ἀθουκιΐμ·

verses.translation: These are the potters who dwelt in Ataim and Gadira with the king: they grew strong in his kingdom, and dwelt there.

translations.ron: Aceştia erau olari şi trăiau la grădini şi la livezi şi prin cetăţi; ei trăiau acolo la rege ca să-i lucreze lui.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι κεραμεῖς οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ἀταῒμ καὶ Γαδιρὰ μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως, ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐνίσχυσαν, καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ.

verses.translation: The sons of Semeon; Namuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zares, Saul:

translations.ron: Fiii lui Simeon au fost: Nemuel, Iamin, Iarib, Zerah şi Saul.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σεμεὼν, Ναμουὴλ, καὶ Ἰαμὶν, Ἰαρὶβ, Ζαρὲς, Σαοὺλ,

verses.translation: Salem his son, Mabasam his son, Masma his son:

translations.ron: Fiul lui Saul a fost Şalum, fiul acestuia a fost Mibsam, iar al acestuia a fost Mişma.
translations.grk: Σαλὲμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Μαβασὰμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Μασμὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,

verses.translation: Amuel his son, Sabud his son, Zacchur his son, Semei his son.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Mişma au fost: Hamuel, fiul lui; fiul acestuia a fost Zacur, iar al acestuia a fost Şimei.
translations.grk: Σεμεῒ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ·

verses.translation: Semei had sixteen sons, and six daughters; and his brethren had not many sons, neither did all their families multiply as the sons of Juda.

translations.ron: Şimei a avut şaisprezece fii şi şase fete, iar fraţii lui au avut puţini copii şi tot neamul lor n-a fost aşa de numeros ca neamul fiilor lui Iuda.
translations.grk: Τῷ Σεμεῒ υἱοὶ ἑκκαίδεκα, καὶ θυγατέρες ἕξ· καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν οὐκ ἦσαν υἱοὶ πολλοί· καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπλεόνασαν ὡς υἱοὶ Ἰούδα.

verses.translation: And they dwelt in Bersabee, and Molada, and in Esersual,

translations.ron: Ei trăiau în Beer-Şeba, Molada şi Haţar-Şual,
translations.grk: Καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐν Βηρσαβεὲ, καὶ Μωλαδὰ, καὶ ἐν Ἑσερσουὰλ,

verses.translation: and in Balaa, and in Æsem, and in Tholad,

translations.ron: În Bilha, Eţem, Tolad,
translations.grk: καὶ ἐν Βαλαὰ, καὶ ἐν Αἰσὲμ, καὶ ἐν Θωλὰδ,

verses.translation: and in Bathuel, and in Herma, and in Sikelag,

translations.ron: Betuel, Horma, Ţiclag,
translations.grk: καὶ ἐν Ἑρμὰ, καὶ ἐν Σικελὰγ,

verses.translation: and in Bæthmarimoth, and Hemisuseosin, and the house of Baruseorim: these were their cities until the time of king David.

translations.ron: În Bet-Marcabot, Haţar-Susim, Bet-Birei şi Şaaraim. Iată cetăţile lor dinainte de domnia lui David cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐν Βαιθμαριμὼθ, καὶ Ἡμισουσεωσὶν, καὶ οἴκου Βαρουσεωρίμ· αὗται αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν ἕως βασιλέως Δαυίδ.

verses.translation: And their villages were Ætan, and En, Remnon, and Thocca, and Æsar, five cities.

translations.ron: Şi mai aveau: Etam, Ain, Rimon, Tochen şi Aşan, cinci cetăţi,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν Αἰτὰν, καὶ Ἢν, Ῥεμνὼν, καὶ Θοκκὰ, καὶ Αἰσὰρ, πόλεις πέντε.

verses.translation: And all their villages were round about these cities, as far as Baal: this was their possession, and their distribution.

translations.ron: Cu toate satele lor, care se aflau împrejurul acestor cetăţi până la Baal. Iată locurile lor de locuinţă şi spiţa neamului lor:
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσαι ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν κύκλῳ τῶν πόλεων τούτων ἕως Βάαλ· αὕτη κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν, καὶ ὁ καταλοχισμὸς αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And Mosobab, and Jemoloch, and Josia the son of Amasia;

translations.ron: Meşobab, Iamlec şi Ioşa, fiul lui Amasia
translations.grk: Καὶ Μοσωβὰβ, καὶ Ἰεμολὸχ, καὶ Ἰωσία υἱὸς Ἀμασία,

verses.translation: and Joel, and Jeu the son of Asabia, the son of Sarau, the son of Asiel;

translations.ron: Ioil şi Iehu, fiul lui Ioşibia, fiul lui Seraia, fiul lui Asiel;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰωὴλ, καὶ Ἰηοὺ υἱὸς Ἀσαβία, υἱὸς Σαραῦ, υἱὸς Ἀσιὴλ,

verses.translation: and Elionai, and Jocaba, and Jasuia, and Asaia, and Jediel, and Ismael, and Banaias;

translations.ron: Elioenai, Iaacoba, Ieşohaia, Asaia, Adiel, Ieşimiel, Benaia,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐλιωναῒ, καὶ Ἰωκαβὰ, καὶ Ἰασουία, καὶ Ἀσαΐα, καὶ Ἰεδιὴλ, καὶ Ἰσμαὴλ, καὶ Βαναίας, καὶ Ζουζὰ υἱὸς Σαφαῒ,

verses.translation: and Zuza the son of Saphai, the son of Alon, the son of Jedia, the son of Semri, the son of Samaias.

translations.ron: Ziza, fiul lui Şifei, fiul lui Alon, fiul lui Iedaia, fiul lui Şimri, fiul lui Şemaia.
translations.grk: υἱοῦ Ἀλὼν, υἱοῦ Ἰεδιὰ, υἱοῦ Σεμρὶ, υἱοῦ Σαμαίου.

verses.translation: These went by the names of princes in their families, and they increased abundantly in their fathers' households.

translations.ron: Aceşti numiţi mai sus au fost căpetenii neamurilor lor, iar casa tatălui lor s-a împărţit în multe ramuri.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι οἱ διελθόντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν ἀρχόντων ἐν ταῖς γενέσεσιν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν οἴκοις πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν εἰς πλῆθος.

verses.translation: And they went till they came to Gerara, to the east of Gai, to seek pasture for their cattle.

translations.ron: Ei s-au întins până în partea Gherarei şi până în partea de răsărit a văii Gai, ca să găsească păşuni pentru turmele lor;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν Γέραρα ἕως τῶν ἀνατολῶν τῆς Γαὶ, τοῦ ζητῆσαι νομὰς τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And they found abundant and good pastures, and the land before them was wide, and there was peace and quietness; for there were some of the children of Cham who dwelt there before.

translations.ron: Şi au găsit păşuni grase şi bune şi pământ larg, liniştit şi lipsit de primejdii, pentru că înainte de ei au trăit acolo numai puţini Hamiţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὗρον νομὰς πλεὶονας καὶ ἀγαθάς· καὶ ἡ γῆ πλατεῖα ἐναντίον αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἡσυχία, ὅτι ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Χὰμ τὼν κατοικούντων ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν.

verses.translation: And these who are written by name came in the days of Ezekias king of Juda, and they smote the people's houses, and the Minæans whom they found there, and utterly destroyed them until this day: and they dwelt in their place, because there was pasture there for their cattle.

translations.ron: şi au venit aceştia, care sunt scrişi pe nume, în zilele lui Iezechia, regele Iudei, şi au bătut pe nomazi şi pe cei aşezaţi, care se aflau acolo şi i-au nimicit pentru totdeauna şi s-au aşezat în locul lor, căci acolo se aflau păşuni pentru turmele lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤλθοσαν οὗτοι οἱ γεγραμμένοι ἐπʼ ὀνόματος ἐν ἡμέραις Ἐζεκίου βασιλέως Ἰούδα, καὶ ἐπάταξαν τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς Μιναίους οὕς εὕροσαν ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἀνεθεμάτισαν αὐτοὺς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης· καὶ ᾤκησαν ἀντʼ αὐτῶν, ὅτι νομαὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ.

verses.translation: And some of them, even of the sons of Symeon, went to mount Seir, even five hundred men; and Phalaettia, and Noadia, and Raphaia, and Oziel, sons of Jesi, were their rulers.

translations.ron: Dar din ei, din fiii lui Simeon, s-au dus către muntele Seir cinci sute de oameni, în frunte cu Pelatia, Nearia, Refaia şi Uziel, fiii lui Işei,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Συμεὼν ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς ὄρος Σηὶρ ἄνδρες πεντακόσιοι, καὶ Φαλαεττία, καὶ Νωαδία, καὶ Ῥαφαΐα, καὶ Ὀζιὴλ υἱοὶ Ἰεσὶ ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And they smote the remnant that were left of Amalec, until this day.

translations.ron: Şi au bătut rămăşiţa de Amaleciţi, ce se mai găsea acolo, şi trăiesc acolo până în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπάταξαν τοὺς καταλοίπους τοὺς καταλειφθέντας τοῦ Ἀμαλὴκ ἕως ἡμέρας ταύτης.
